title: 4k Differences from the AVA Map Explorer polygon - layer (the big ones, and all of them)

properties.description:
Hickory Sands District AVA (Docket No. TTB-2026-0005, Notice No. 243, 91 FR 52576): the boundary the petitioners propose, with the changes discussed with TTB on October 15, 2026. Prepared by Dan McLaughlin, Robert Clay Vineyards (petitioner).

Two layers comparing the proposed revision (red, drawn from the proposed text) with the AVA Map Explorer polygon (blue, TTB's AVAs_Production layer for Notice No. 243). The Map Explorer polygon was digitized by hand; the proposed revision follows the centre of the printed linework of the USGS maps.
